community.llmFallbackReason:
What it is: a community Skill or Agent-instruction reference the model judged relevant to the current topic.

How it helps the Skills workbench: it adds community reference sources and helps compare locally generated drafts against mature external practice.

When to look at it: open the source to check its structure when deciding whether the current local Skill should be merged, replaced, rewritten or given more steps.

What to check first: the README, example prompts, agent instructions, workflow or rules files.
community.seedDescription: Local Skill "{name}" - related community projects recommended from your actual usage data
community.seedReason:
What it is: a community reference entry generated from the Skill "{name}" you already have installed locally{categoryHint}.

How it helps the Skills workbench: your workflows already use this Skill, and the community may have a better implementation of the same kind to reference, compare or merge.

When to look at it: open it when the current Skill's instructions are not precise enough, do not cover enough scenarios, or when you want to see how the community solves the same problem.

What to check first: the README, example directory, agent instructions or workflow files from the search results.
